name: Clarify an ambiguous emotional statement
short_description: Clarify an ambiguous emotional statement once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can clarify an ambiguous emotional statement in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Clarify an ambiguous emotional statement means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Clarify an ambiguous emotional statement in a fresh real-life scenario.
